tools.name: get_post
tools.description:
Return a single post or page from rafeblandford.com by slug, with its FULL TEXT, tags, dates and authorship label.

Use search_writing first if you do not have a slug — a blank query there returns the most recent writing, and every result carries the slug you need here. The slug is the last path seg

tools.name: search_writing
tools.description:
Keyword search over everything published on rafeblandford.com — the FULL TEXT of every post, plus the About and Career pages.

Deterministic by design: it matches titles, tags, excerpts and body text and ranks by a fixed score. No model, no embeddings — the same query always returns the same results

tools.name: check_experience
tools.description:
Ask whether this site publishes anything evidencing a topic — a technology, a sector, a discipline, a kind of leadership.

Returns `supported`, `partial` or `not_found`, a plain-language statement, and source URLs you can check.

⚠️ PASS A SUBJECT, NOT A SENTENCE. Matching is on whole words, so a lo

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_experience" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Ask whether this site publishes anything evidencing a topic — a technology, a sector, a discipline, a kind of leadership. Returns `supported`, `partial` or `not…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_evidence, get_post, search_writing, check_experience · Private data: get_evidence, check_experience · Public sink: get_evidence, get_post, search_writing, check_experience.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_evidence, get_post, search_writing, check_experience · Private data: get_evidence, check_experience · Public sink: get_evidence, get_post, search_writing, check_experience

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
